project.title: Warehouse Layout and Handling Optimization for Metal Goods
project.objective: Redesign warehouse layout and handling routines for metal products to cut handling time, reduce damage, and improve inventory accuracy.
deliverables: Current-state mapping of warehouse layout and handling flows
New zoning and storage layout for metal goods and finished items
Standard operating procedures for moving and loading activities
Updated inventory location and coding scheme
Training checklist and brief for movers and operators
constraints: All changes must be implemented without full warehouse shutdown
Compliance with health and safety measures in transportation and handling
No new heavy machinery purchases; reuse existing equipment
Maintain access to dangerous goods and heavy items per regulations
Inventory system structure cannot be changed, only locations and codes
Initial rollout limited to metal goods and related packaging areas

risks.risk: Disruption to daily loading and unloading during layout changes.
risks.mitigation: Phase changes by zone, schedule work in low-traffic hours, and pre-brief movers on temporary routes.

risks.risk: Staff not following new procedures and reverting to old habits.
risks.mitigation: Create simple SOPs, run short on-floor demos, and use checklists for the first weeks.

risks.risk: Inventory mismatches due to location changes not being updated correctly.
risks.mitigation: Require dual sign-off on location updates and run daily cycle counts in changed zones for one week.

risks.risk: Safety incidents when moving heavy or dangerous goods in new paths.
risks.mitigation: Review hazards in each new route, mark risk areas clearly, and validate with health and safety officer before go-live.

themes.why_relevant: Core to reducing travel distance for movers and improving picking and loading efficiency.
New routes and stacking rules must respect safety standards and dangerous goods regulations.
Location and coding updates must align with existing inventory rules to avoid stock errors.
Optimizing use of existing trolleys, forklifts, and sawing areas without new investments.
Movers and operators need clear, simple guidance to adopt new routines quickly.

backlog.task: Map current warehouse layout, flows, and high-traffic routes for metal goods
definition_of_done: Sketch or diagram of current zones and aisles completed
List of typical routes for movers and operators documented
Bottleneck and congestion points identified and shared

backlog.task: Identify and document handling pain points for movers and operators
definition_of_done: At least 10 concrete pain points collected from daily work
Pain points grouped by type (safety, time loss, damage risk)
Top 5 issues prioritized and shared with team

backlog.task: Design new zoning plan for metal goods, cut pieces, and finished items
definition_of_done: Draft zoning map created with clear labels
Travel distance for typical moves estimated and reduced vs current
Zoning plan validated with one mover and one operator

backlog.task: Define safe handling routes and stacking rules for heavy and dangerous goods
definition_of_done: List of safe routes between cutting area, storage, and loading docks documented
Stacking limits and packaging rules for key items defined
Health and safety officer feedback incorporated

backlog.task: Update inventory location list to match new zoning and coding rules
definition_of_done: All affected SKUs assigned to new locations in location list
Location codes checked against existing coding system
Sample of 20 items verified physically against updated list

backlog.task: Create simple SOPs for moving, packing, and loading metal goods in new layout
definition_of_done: Step-by-step procedures drafted for at least 3 common move types
Hazard notes and PPE requirements included
SOPs reviewed by inventory coordinator and one operator

backlog.task: Define interface rules between sawing area and storage zones
definition_of_done: Standard pallet or container types for cut pieces defined
Handover points and labeling rules agreed with inventory coordinator
Trial run of new interface completed and feedback logged

backlog.task: Plan phased implementation schedule by warehouse zone
definition_of_done: Zones grouped into at least 3 implementation phases
Low-traffic time windows identified for each phase
Schedule shared with movers and operators in advance

backlog.task: Prepare training brief and on-floor demo plan for movers
definition_of_done: Key changes summarized in one-page brief
Short demo route defined to show new paths and stacking rules
At least two demo sessions scheduled across shifts

backlog.task: Set up post-implementation safety and performance checklist
definition_of_done: Checklist items covering safety, time, and damage created
Daily check routine for first two weeks defined
Responsibility for completing checklist assigned per shift

backlog.task: Validate new layout and routes with trial day and capture issues
definition_of_done: Trial day completed using new layout in at least one zone
All incidents, delays, and confusion points logged
List of quick fixes agreed with inventory coordinator

backlog.task: Adjust machine-side material staging to fit new warehouse zones
definition_of_done: Material staging areas near machines re-marked to match new zones
Tool and packaging placement adjusted for smoother flow
Operator confirms no extra walking vs previous setup
